cook_something_new.title: Cook something neither of you has made
cook_something_new.summary: Pick a recipe you've both never tried. Being equally bad at it is the point.

early_dinner_late_walk.title: Early dinner, long walk after
early_dinner_late_walk.summary: Book somewhere for six. The walk home is the half you'll remember.

live_music_small_room.title: Live music somewhere small
live_music_small_room.summary: A bar with one act on a weeknight beats an arena and costs a tenth as much.

revisit_first_date.title: Go back to where you had your first date
revisit_first_date.summary: If it's closed, go to whatever replaced it and complain about the change.

market_then_breakfast.title: Market in the morning, breakfast after
market_then_breakfast.summary: Buy one thing you can't identify and work out what to do with it.

trivia_or_quiz.title: Pub quiz as a team of two
trivia_or_quiz.summary: You will lose. Losing together is a surprisingly good evening.

drive_no_destination.title: Drive with no destination
drive_no_destination.summary: Pick left or right at every junction for an hour, then find somewhere to eat.

cinema_you_would_not_pick.title: See the film you'd never choose
cinema_you_would_not_pick.summary: Each of you picks for the other. No vetoes.

one_train_away.title: One train ride away
one_train_away.summary: The first town far enough that the buildings look different. Two nights is plenty.

cabin_no_signal.title: Somewhere with no signal
cabin_no_signal.summary: Book the place with bad reviews about the wifi. That's the feature.

city_you_both_dismissed.title: The city you've both written off
city_you_both_dismissed.summary: Somewhere neither of you rates. Low expectations travel well.

spa_or_hot_springs.title: Somewhere with hot water
spa_or_hot_springs.summary: Springs, a spa, a lake in summer. Something that makes sitting still feel earned.

coast_out_of_season.title: The coast, out of season
coast_out_of_season.summary: Half the price, none of the crowds, and better light for it.

walk_between_two_towns.title: Walk between two towns
walk_between_two_towns.summary: Train out, walk back over a day, sleep somewhere in the middle.

language_neither_speaks.title: Somewhere neither of you speaks the language
language_neither_speaks.summary: Being equally lost is the closest thing to a shared beginner's mind.

long_rail_journey.title: A long journey by rail
long_rail_journey.summary: Pick the route, not the destination. Days of watching the window go by.

island_off_season.title: An island, slowly
island_off_season.summary: One place for two weeks instead of five places in ten days.

revisit_ten_years_on.title: Somewhere one of you loved ten years ago
revisit_ten_years_on.summary: Show the other person the version of you that went there.

walk_a_long_route.title: Walk a route with a name
walk_a_long_route.summary: A week on a marked trail. Nothing to decide each morning except when to start.

somewhere_cold.title: Somewhere properly cold
somewhere_cold.summary: Northern lights, deep winter, thick coats. The opposite of every holiday photo.
